summary: Good to Great podcast with Arnab Sinha, founder of UClean (900+ stores across 10 countries and 255 cities, ~Rs 210 crores system sales last FY, EBITDA and PAT positive except COVID). Deep dive into UClean franchise unit economics: Rs 20-25L initial investment (Rs 7L one-time franchise fee, ~Rs 10-11L equipment, ~Rs 5L store fit-out) plus ~Rs 5L working capital; ~80% gross margins; break-even at ~Rs 1.5L monthly sales (3-4 months); stable stores at Rs 3.5-4L sales earn ~35-40% margins (~Rs 1.5L/month take-home); 7% royalty from month 4; top 1% stores do Rs 6.5-7L sales with ~Rs 3-3.5L profit; peak season October-March, tough May-July. Also covers risks: boring/unglamorous business, franchise scams, fly-by-night operators. Calls: none - UClean is private.
title: Make ₹2 Lakh Profit Per Month with a Laundry Business - How to Start This Business? | Rahul Jain G2G
